_comment: Phase 85 Plan 07 — the SAME mapped-staff window as appointments.json MINUS the second slot (appt-mapped-2 gone, e.g. the client cancelled/moved). Drives the hard-replace test: a re-sync against this fixture must HARD-DELETE the appt-mapped-2 row (not soft) and count appointmentsRemoved >= 1. The surviving item still carries real PII so the SA-02 drop invariant stays exercised. v3 shape: date in appointmentDate, LocalTime 'HH:mm:ss' times. The test rewrites appointmentDate onto an in-window date.
